notes: GAAP county, following Lancaster_County_FY2023's structure. Governmental receipts/disbursements/transfers/fund balances from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Taxes 110,292,854 split: lodging tax 4,081,297 (Visitors Improvement 2,040,648 + County Visitors Promotion 2,040,649 fund taxes, p13; ties exactly to the Statement of Activities 'Lodging tax', p3) and drug tax 14,155 (Federal Grants Fund taxes = Statement of Activities 'Drug tax'); the remaining 106,197,402 (General Fund and five nonmajor funds) mixes property, inheritance, motor vehicle, in-lieu, occupation and nameplate taxes whose accrual Statement of Activities amounts do not tie, so it stays taxes. No Gaming Tax fund exists in FY2022. Other financing sources: 'Leases' 376,063 recorded as debt_proceeds (lease financing); proceeds from sale of capital assets 153,454 as other_financing. Transfers in 21,998,965 vs out 22,399,558: the 400,593 difference went to the internal service funds (pp7, 31). Only internal service funds exist (pp6-8, 31-32), so business_type is null; the ISF cash flow statement (p8) is recorded in proprietary. ending_cash is the governmental funds Balance Sheet 'Cash and investments' 131,670,872 (p4); beginning cash not printed. governmental_net_position from the Statement of Activities (p3). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (single Governmental Activities column, p2). Detail: budgetary-basis budget schedules for every fund: General Fund (pp9-10, department totals, not itemized), Veterans Aid sub-fund (p30), Federal Grants (p11; function public safety from the statement's Federal Grants column, mostly public safety), and the nonmajor funds (pp15-29). The General Fund combining schedule (p12) and nonmajor combining statement (pp13-14) are not recorded because every fund has its own budget schedule. Lines with no actual amount (dashes) omitted; dash budgets recorded as 0. Intergovernmental lines use other state aid (no grantor printed); Mental Health 'County aid' (= its transfers in on p13) kept as printed revenue (decision_needed). Bridge 'Other revenue' 18,675 and Property Management 'Other receipts' 5,200 equal the combining statement's sale of capital assets for those funds, so they take Sale of Property. Capital outlay lines are labelled with a function only where the fund name names one (Highway, Bridge and Special Road, Weed Control); Federal Grants, Building, Property Management and City Building Maintenance capital lines are labelled 'Capital Outlay'. Read pages 1-32 of 32
